record.question: Even though Mercury is closer to the Sun than Venus, Mercury is colder. What is the reason?
options: It has fumes of Sulphuric Acid
record.explanation: Answer C: Greeenhouse effect. Mercury lacks a substantial atmosphere to retain heat; Venus’s dense carbon-dioxide atmosphere creates a strong greenhouse effect. Option (c) names the greenhouse effect. Reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mercury/facts/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
